Lexar SSD DiskMaster 1.2.0. - DiskMaster application for Lexar Solid-State Drives (SSD). Supported OS: Windows7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11 (32 and 64 bit).

This application allows you to obtain useful information on Lexar SSDs (capacity, serial number, firmware version, health status, temperature, free and used space, interface, etc.) but also to generate a SMART monitoring report, update the firmware, detect the remaining lifespan, erase all data stored on the SSD (secure erase) or migrate data between two drives. It replaces the SSD Dash application.
